title: Tomato and Egg Two Ways

ingredients.name: cherry tomatoes
ingredients.rawText: Version A: 400 g cherry tomatoes, halved

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.rawText: Version A: 6 eggs, divided into three pairs

ingredients.name: light soy sauce
ingredients.rawText: Version A: 20 g light soy sauce

ingredients.name: cooking oil
ingredients.rawText: Version A: cooking oil, as needed

ingredients.name: tomatoes
ingredients.rawText: Version B: 5 medium tomatoes (about 1 kg), divided between chunks and dice

ingredients.name: water or stock
ingredients.rawText: Version B: about 3/4 cup water or stock

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.rawText: Version B: chopped scallions, to taste

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.rawText: Version B: 1/2 tsp salt for the sauce

ingredients.name: light soy sauce
ingredients.rawText: Version B: 1 tbsp light soy sauce

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.rawText: Version B: 1/2 tsp salt for the eggs

ingredients.name: cornstarch slurry
ingredients.rawText: Version B: cornstarch slurry, as needed

ingredients.name: cooking oil
ingredients.rawText: Version B: cooking oil, as needed

steps.text: A — Ricky Cheung: Trim and halve the cherry tomatoes horizontally. Fry two eggs in a little oil until firm, season with salt and set aside.
A: Beat two more eggs with salt; scramble over high heat until just set and set aside.
A: Slowly cook the sliced onion in oil with a little salt until soft. Add stock and half the tomatoes; cover and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes.
A: Quarter the fried eggs. Add these and the scrambled eggs to the tomato sauce with light soy sauce and Tabasco; cook over medium heat for 1 minute.

A: Beat the remaining two eggs with salt and pour evenly over the sauce. Arrange the remaining tomatoes on top, season lightly, cover and cook over medium heat for 1 minute until set. Finish with scallions.
B — Jacky Yu: Score the tomatoes, blanch for about 20 seconds, cool in ice water and peel. Divide between chunks and small dice.
B: Beat five eggs with 1/2 tsp salt. Heat generous oil in a wok, slowly pour in the eggs and fry until fluffy and just set. Remove and drain.
B: Fry minced garlic and ginger until fragrant. Add diced tomatoes, soften and mash into a sauce.
B: Add water or stock, tomato chunks, ketchup, tomato paste, sugar, sauce salt, light soy sauce and pepper. Simmer for about 3 minutes until soft.
B: Return the eggs and fold gently. Add a little cornstarch slurry only if needed to glaze the sauce. Finish with shallot oil and scallions.

notes: Choose version A (Ricky Cheung's cherry tomatoes with eggs three ways) or version B (Jacky Yu's home-style tomato and egg). Ingredient lines are labeled for each version; they are not intended to be combined.
